question: Do the Atg5 precedent and preserved A13/A20/A8/A19/A22 results provide jointly linked matrix and mature epithelial endpoints for the proposed ARG1 effect question?
decision: Return source/replicate and endpoint maps, exact T1 eligibility or holds, and bounded capability requirements; stop at T0 for review.
strongest_rival: Misidentifying source sample labels, assay denominators or related-study outcomes as independent donors, paired preparations, flux or mature functional repair.
discriminator: Read published figures/legends/methods/supplements and current repository results; preserve source-specific units and unknown joins. Verify metadata against exact acquired primary files without new effect estimation.
exposure_record: Published outcomes, figures, legends, methods and supplements; repository results; GEO metadata; Figshare workbook text headers/sample labels and visibly plotted outcomes were read before freeze. Workbook numeric measurements were not extracted or analyzed. All source acquisition preceded freeze. Initial GEO targ=all request exceeded a 5 MB cap and was discarded unread; successful header-only sample records contain zero data rows. No expression matrix, raw MS, kinetic flux, new classifier or new biological effect analysis.
biological_unit: Published Atg5 mice/fibroblast preparations and AT2 organoid cultures. Mouse-to-well/AT2-source/colony/image joins and cross-matrix endpoints unresolved; source n labels are not assumed independent wells.
nesting_and_overlap: Repeated samples, metabolites, wells, images and cells nest within biological units. Hamanaka publication, Figshare and GEO are one study; reanalysis is not replication. Atg5, Lee and Yadav are separate interventions/contexts and cannot be joined into one causal contrast.
population_and_selection: Authorized Atg5 Figs2/6 and relevant methods/S5-S9, plus current A13/A20/A8/A19/A22 results and reviewed Yadav endpoints. Full6L-M included to avoid omitting the staining evidence.
contrast: Source availability, declared unit/normalizer/time, sample-label and endpoint coverage only. No cross-study numerical effect or population inference.
endpoint: Exact endpoint/denominator/unit/timing coverage and missing matrix-to-mature-output linkage; source access/hash records.
methods: Frozen curated primary-source map plus deterministic source-access verification. BR parses only XLSX string labels and GEO headers, and records file sizes; E exports the source-grounded endpoint map. Independent openpyxl/XML/GEO reread and figure/PDF visual inspection precede interpretation.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain unknown donor/preparation/pairing, timing, calibration, denominator and source values. Keep negative/media-specific results and disagreements. Reject HTML challenge responses as PDFs; do not repair ambiguous isotope headers, invent a fourth4F sample, join unrelated assays or fill missing measurements with zero.
multiplicity: Not applicable: metadata qualification; no effect tests or screening.
precision_basis: No biological effect estimated; metadata counts are not sample-size or power justification.
interpretation_limit: Processed isotope pools/fractions are not kinetic flux, collagen incorporation or functional necessity. Relative proteins, organoid count/diameter, RNA and marker ratios are not absolute lineage-linked mature epithelial repair. Atg5 is not ARG1; separate sources do not establish a joint effect. Execution confers no novelty, laboratory readiness, claim promotion or human acceptance.
stop_rule: Stop after T0 source/metadata qualification and exact T1 design/hold review. No source-value effect estimation, expression processing, raw-MS correction/flux, cross-study joint effect, new classifier, raw reads, large acquisition, bench execution, outreach or Notion/remote writes.
amendment_reason: New authorized T0 follow-up from reviewed plan1473ad87d1246d336402d2ea5f6a2881bc51d774; retains all earlier contracts, receipts, source evidence and holds.
